gaps.sentence: The concert tickets sold ___ within an hour.
gaps.explanation: sell out = all tickets/goods are sold.

gaps.sentence: She ___ down an offer from a rival university.
The old buses are being phased ___ next year.
gaps.explanation: phase out = stop using something gradually.

gaps.sentence: It took the committee weeks to wade ___ the paperwork.
gaps.hint: wade ___ = plod through a lot of
gaps.explanation: 'Wade through' = work slowly through a large amount of tedious material.

gaps.sentence: Can I ___ on these boots before buying them?
gaps.explanation: try on = put on clothes/shoes to check the fit.

gaps.sentence: She put her ideas ___ clearly and confidently.
gaps.explanation: put across = communicate an idea successfully.

gaps.sentence: Many consumers now opt ___ cheaper brands.
The new stadium made ___ an impressive sight.
gaps.explanation: make for = produce a particular result (make for a good atmosphere); also move towards.
